jobs.title: Director, Finance and Health Records
jobs.description:
At Headwaters Health Care Centre,
we are proud to serve our community with compassion, accountability, and teamwork. We are seeking a Director, Finance and Health Records
who is motivated by purpose, values collaboration, and wants to make a meaningful impact in a community hospital setting.

About the Role

Reporting to the Vice President, Corporate Services and Chief Financial Officer, this senior leadership role provides strategic and operational oversight for Finance, Health Records, Materials Management, and hospital‑owned medical office buildings. The Director plays a critical role in advancing financial sustainability, strengthening data‑informed decision‑making, and ensuring the integrity and accessibility of health information that supports high‑quality patient care.

As a trusted partner to clinical and corporate leaders, the Director leads core financial functions including budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, audits, procurement, and internal controls, while also championing excellence in health information management, privacy, and digital health optimization. The role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to organizational strategy, quality improvement, and collaboration across the broader health system, while supporting the operational and financial performance of commercial rental facilities located on hospital property.

This is an ideal opportunity for a principled, forward‑thinking leader who enjoys working in a dynamic environment, values collaboration, and is passionate about using financial and information stewardship to enable excellent care.

What You’ll Do

Provide strategic leadership for financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and audits
Champion excellence by leading and supporting high‑quality health records, privacy, data integrity, and digital health systems
Oversee procurement and materials management in alignment with public‑sector best practices and with a focus on stewardship and transparency
Manage the financial and operational performance of hospital‑owned medical office buildings
Partner with leaders to assess risks, develop business cases, and drive continuous improvement
Support Board, committee, and external reporting relationships with clarity and accountability
Lead, mentor, and develop high‑performing teams, fostering engagement, growth and building strong succession and talent pipelines

What You Bring

You are a principled and collaborative leader who brings both professional expertise and a strong commitment to public service and patient‑centred care.
A commitment to public service and patient‑centred care, grounded in integrity, accountability, and collaboration
Progressive senior‑level financial leadership experience in a hospital or complex health‑care environment
A CPA designation, with strong expertise in financial planning, reporting, audits, and stewardship of public resources
The ability to translate financial, clinical, and operational data into meaningful insights that support decision‑making
Experience leading or supporting large‑scale information system implementations and digital optimization initiatives
A people‑centred leadership style, with a proven ability to engage, develop, and inspire high‑performing teams
Strong judgment, analytical thinking, and comfort navigating complexity and change
A collaborative mindset, with experience working in unionized environments and partnering across the health system

Hours of Work:
37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday

Hiring Salary Range:
$160,602 - $188,955
We are currently hiring for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Sales Director for Cloud & AI
jobs.description:
Overview

Overview

Are you curious and deeply passionate about technology and sales, and ready to tackle complex challenges in a dynamic environment in the era of AI? Are you passionate about empowering financial sector customers to achieve more with technology and help them succeed in their digital transformation?If so, we invite you to join our Canadian team as a Solution Sales Director for Cloud & AI
at Microsoft. In this role, you will be at the forefront of innovation, working on cutting‑edge projects that leverage the latest cloud and AI technologies to drive meaningful impact for citizens and a variety of industries. Join us and be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning. Microsoft believes that our Canadian organizations have a unique opportunity to transform society at scale. From central government and agencies to local authorities, healthcare institutions and education, these organizations are reinventing how they deliver secure, trusted and efficient services to citizens. With Microsoft Cloud, we aspire to empower every finance sector organization to innovate and modernize on our platform, while meeting the highest standards of security, compliance and digital sovereignty.

Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Deal Execution

Lead the sales team responsible for driving Cloud & AI revenue across accounts, ensuring disciplined execution of the end‑to‑end sales cycle (prospection → qualification → deal shaping → closing).
Ensure teams adhere to Microsoft sales methodologies (including AI‑enhanced sales frameworks) to qualify opportunities, accelerate deal velocity and improve win rates.
Orchestrate complex deal cycles involving procurement, multi‑stakeholder governance, and compliance constraints typical of the French Financial Sector.
Coach sellers on how to engage, influence and secure executive alignment with C‑level decision makers (CEO, CIO, CTO/CDO, Business Line Leaders) to land Microsoft Cloud value propositions.
Drive competitive positioning, ensuring the team can clearly articulate differentiators against hyperscalers and specialized competitors.

Sales Leadership & People Management

Microsoft managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by Modeling, Coaching and Caring
:

Model: Embody Microsoft leadership principles, customer obsession, integrity, and inclusiveness.
Coach: Set clear revenue targets and performance expectations, support deal strategy, help sellers adapt, learn and improve continuously.
Care: Attract, develop, and retain great sales talent; understand individual motivations; and support team members’ career growth.

Concrete Expectations

Build a strong, high‑performing sales culture: discipline in forecasting, usage of tools (MSX, CRM), robust pipeline management.
Establish a consistent coaching rhythm (1:1s, forecast reviews, opportunity strategy sessions, joint customer engagements).
Help sellers strengthen their executive communication skills—ensuring compelling, outcome‑focused conversations with Finance Sector leaders.

Sales Strategy & Pipeline Management

Own Cloud & AI revenue results for the territory: pipeline health, forecasting accuracy, bookings, consumption growth, and renewal performance.
Guide teams in building and maintaining high-quality pipelines with sufficient coverage, leveraging data (propensity, consumption trends, renewal risk, competitive signals) to prioritize and optimize effort.
Lead regular pipeline and forecast reviews with internal stakeholders, ensuring data‑driven decision making and early risk identification.
Ensure disciplined execution of sales plays aligned with Microsoft’s Cloud & AI priorities (modernization, data & AI, digital sovereignty, cybersecurity, app innovation, etc.).
Drive whitespace analysis and identify new growth vectors across industries

Account Strategy & Cross‑Team Collaboration

Partner closely with Account Executives (AEs) to strengthen account strategies and ensure Cloud & AI sales motions are fully embedded in the account plans.
Collaborate with Customer Success, Marketing, Partner teams and industry specialists to maximize impact, support strategic engagements, and ensure value realization for customers.
Foster strong collaboration with the partner ecosystem (GSIs, local integrators, software vendors, start‑ups) to drive differentiated, customer‑aligned solutions.
Ensure storytelling, customer references, and ecosystem success stories are captured and shared to fuel future wins.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Information Security, or related field AND 8+ years experience in technology-related sales or account management OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Management, Engineering, or any relevant field — OR equivalent practical experience.
Experience in complex enterprise sales, ideally in cloud, software, digital transformation, or technology markets.
Experience leading sales teams, including field sellers and/or virtual teams in competitive, high‑stakes environments.
Demonstrated experience selling to regulated industries, with strong understanding of procurement cycles, governance, and compliance requirements.
Proven ability to manage large opportunities and multi‑million‑euro deal cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
Executive presence and communication skills; ability to simplify complex value propositions and engage Finance Sector leadership.
Data‑driven mindset applied to forecasting, pipeline analysis, and revenue planning.
